row: Do you want to move without pain getting in your way?  We know how frustrating it can be when pain stops you from living your life.  You deserve to freely move within your home, community, or sport without pain.  Since 2007 the doctors of physical therapy at BSR have helped thousands of people move without pain. Call us today.  Schedule your initial evaluation with a physical therapist.  Your physical therapist will teach you how to move without pain. Your physical therapist will listen to your concerns, teach you how to move, keep you on track, and progress your treatment until you achieve your goals. Don't let your pain stop you anymore.  After completing physical therapy you will have control over your pain and be back to living the life you deserve.
